summary: postinstall harvests AWS/GCP credential env vars and launches unrelated OS command
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script runs `env | grep 'AWS\|GCP\|GOOGLE' | nc localhost 8000`, enumerating the installer's cloud-provider credential environment variables and piping them to netcat on install. It also executes `open /System/Applications/Calculator.app`, an OS action unrelated to the advertised background-color helper. Both actions fire automatically on `npm install` via the declared postinstall hook. The netcat destination in this build is loopback, but the credential-harvesting shape and unrelated command execution are the install-time credential theft and RCE patterns.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
